name: DotP Complete
description: Adds the 373 named set entries missing from the default pool: 369 cross-set reprints and four new rules identities, completing all eight Duels of the Planeswalkers card-group checklists.
rules_note: Chaos Orb, Falling Star, Shahrazad, and Word of Command use clearly marked digital adaptations because their tabletop procedures cannot be reproduced faithfully in this duel interface. Reprints share one name-based rules identity and the same copy accounting.
